subject.title: [Feature]: Add description and enum to message tool's channel parameter

question: Should the linked description-only PR fully resolve this issue, or must the message tool also expose a registry-derived enum for `channel`?
rationale: The description is a narrow, proven usability fix, but choosing an enum establishes a model-facing plugin compatibility contract that should not be inferred from the contributor patch alone.

options.title: Accept description-only
options.body: Land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/84589 and treat a dynamic enum as separate follow-up work only if further misuse evidence warrants it.

options.title: Require registry-derived enum
options.body: Revise the candidate to enumerate active provider and channel-plugin IDs with focused bundled and external-plugin compatibility coverage.

recommendation.title: Accept description-only
recommendation.body: Land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/84589 and treat a dynamic enum as separate follow-up work only if further misuse evidence warrants it.

likelyOwner.reason: They already reviewed the exact schema and routing boundary and are the strongest available owner for deciding whether description-only guidance is the intended contract.
